# Recreation Prompt

Recreate `VHS Heartwraith: Scrub the Static` as a single-page mobile browser canvas game. Preserve the mechanic truth of the source: one target is active at a time; the pointer-following avatar moves by lerp; fast swiping over the target within a radius fills progress; a timer counts down; completion awards one score/streak and spawns the next target; timeout opens a game-over modal; restart resets the loop.

Rebuild all presentation as an unhinged Kingdom Hearts-inspired VHS ghost fantasy. The player is a translucent Heartwraith ghost with a gold key-shaped scrubber tail. Targets are cursed heart-tape relics with glyphs like crowns, keys, wings, hearts, and eyes. The world is a glitched stained-glass void chapel inside a possessed cassette. Use scanlines, tracking-error text, chromatic cyan/pink shadows, gold/cyan/pink particles, and procedural canvas art. HUD language should use Hearts Rewound, Chain Glitch, Tape Stability, Static Exorcism Speed, and Tape Possession.

# Blueprint

## Source Game Truth
- genre: mobile-first timed arcade cleaning / single-target swipe action
- objective: rapidly move the pointer-following scrubber over the active target until its progress reaches 100 before its timer expires
- input model: pointerdown/pointermove/pointerup on the canvas; active swiping speed determines scrubbing state; restart is a normal button click/tap
- core loop: spawn one target, chase it with the scrubber, scrub while moving quickly inside the collision radius, award score and streak, spawn the next target, lose when the target timer reaches zero
- fail/friction state: timer decay on each spawned object; warning near low time; game-over overlay and restart when time reaches zero

## Protected Mechanics
- One active target at a time, spawned near the lower-middle playfield.
- Pointer-following tool uses the same 0.2 lerp and scrubbing threshold of movement greater than 5 pixels.
- Scrub collision remains distance less than target radius plus 20 while scrubbing.
- Scrub progress uses the configurable speed value of 60 by default and max progress of 100.
- Patience/tape timer remains 8 seconds by default, with game over on timeout.
- Score and streak increment by one on each completed target; restart resets score, streak, particles, target, and state.

## Remix Blueprint
The canonical rebuild is `VHS Heartwraith: Scrub the Static`, a Kingdom Hearts-inspired haunted tape arcade game. The player controls a VHS ghost wielding a keyblade-like scrubber to rewind cursed heart-tapes before static consumes them. The old food/dish presentation is not protected and is replaced by glowing heart relics, corrupted tape rings, cathedral-rift background motifs, scanline glitches, and unhinged haunted copy.
